method.value: Two methods: CO(4-3) luminosity with r41 and alpha_CO, and 3 mm dust continuum extrapolated to rest-frame 850 um to give dust then gas mass

evidence.quote: We estimate the molecular gas mass in the components related to the DRC using two methods, via the 3-mm continuum and the CO(4–3) line emission.

findings_qualitative.value: Three new CO(4-3) members (C, D, E) of the DRC at z=4.002 found, plus a tentative companion D'; F and G show lines at other redshifts; H is spurious

evidence.quote: We find new members of DRC in three SMG fields; in two fields, the SMGs are shown to lie along the line of sight towards DRC; one SMG is spurious.

findings_qualitative.value: Most newly confirmed members are not the brightest continuum emitters in their fields

evidence.quote: the majority of newly confirmed members of the DRC protocluster are not the brightest 3-mm continuum emitters in their respective field

claims.hypothesis: Do LABOCA sources C-H within 3 arcmin of the DRC belong to the protocluster?
claims.experiment: ALMA Band 3 12CO(4-3) and 97 GHz continuum pointings towards each source
claims.result: CO(4-3) lines at frequencies near z=4.002 in fields C, D and E; lines at 102.6 and 103.9 GHz in F and G; nothing in H
claims.finding: C, D, E are new DRC members; F and G are line-of-sight; H is likely spurious

evidence.quote: We regard these as confirmed members of the DRC protocluster at $z = 4.002$
one SMG is spurious

claims.hypothesis: Is the rate of protocluster association consistent with the over-density predicted from LABOCA counts?
claims.experiment: Count confirmed members among the six LABOCA sources
claims.result: Four new members (two towards one source) of six sources
claims.finding: Association rate is in line with the ~2.15x over-density, but associations with the brightest SMGs are rarer than expected

evidence.quote: This rate of associations is in line with the $\sim2.15\times$ over-density predicted by (cite: lewis18)
associations with the bright SMGs are rarer than expected, which suggests caution when interpreting continuum over-densities

claims.hypothesis: Does continuum follow-up reveal all gas-rich protocluster members?
claims.experiment: Compare 97 GHz continuum brightness with CO(4-3) line detections in each field
claims.result: Line emitters are associated with weak continuum, and brighter continuum sources in the fields have no line emission
claims.finding: Wide, deep spectral-line imaging is needed to find continuum-faint gas-rich members

evidence.quote: they do not necessarily reveal all of the gas-rich galaxies in each field

claims.hypothesis: Are the new members virialised with the DRC core?
claims.experiment: Compare velocity offsets and separations (~100 arcsec, ~750 kpc) with the core studied by Oteo et al.
claims.result: Three of four new line emitters have offsets of +/-1,000-2,000 km/s, whereas eight of ten core components are within +/-500 km/s
claims.finding: More likely they are in separate halos that will merge with the core, with first interaction in about 1 Gyr

evidence.quote: It is more likely that these components are embedded in dark-matter halos that will eventually merge with the (more massive) core

claims.hypothesis: How can all 14 DRC components be simultaneously in an active star-forming phase?
claims.experiment: Discussion of timescales and stochastic activity
claims.result: New components add modestly to the total SFR (~7,400 Msun/yr)
claims.finding: Simplest explanation is that we see the tip of the iceberg of star formation and gas

evidence.quote: perhaps the simplest explanation is that we are seeing the tip of the iceberg in terms of star formation

why_this_data.value: Search for CO(4-3) towards the six dusty starbursts closest to DRC to test membership

evidence.quote: by searching for the $^{12}$CO(4–3) emission line[^7] towards the six dusty starbursts closest to DRC, components C–H, to test whether they belong to the same structure

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: D' as a fast outflow from D, or both triggered by a fly-by: outflow argued against because emission is compact and does not extend back to D

evidence.quote: The emission is relatively compact and does not extend back to D, which argues against the outflow hypothesis.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Mass of several 1e14 Msun virialised system at 100 arcsec scale judged unlikely

evidence.quote: This seems unlikely, however.

limitations_admitted.value: Individual dust temperatures cannot be estimated for these sources

evidence.quote: We do not have sufficient data to estimate dust temperatures individually for these sources

limitations_admitted.value: Dynamical mass extension to C, D, E is far more uncertain

evidence.quote: is far more uncertain

referee_caveats_inferred: Gas masses depend on assumed alpha_CO, r41, gas-to-dust ratio and dust temperature, and are uncorrected for CMB effects
Spurious/line-of-sight conclusions rest on single lines whose identity (for F and G) is unknown
D' is only a tentative 8 sigma moment-0 detection
Source selection (six LABOCA sources only) limits any statement about the protocluster's full extent

reproducibility.score_reason: Project code and key setup are given, but processing parameters, software versions and measurement procedures are missing; most results are tabulated numbers.
